title: Router (1 stuck = 75% amber, 2 = 150% red) and residential (any = 600% red) strain ladders have no test pin — only the content_host ladder is pinned
evidence:
core/warnings_test.odin:83-84: "// Host throughput 80: 1 packet = 37 % (healthy), 2 = 75 % (amber),
	// 3 = 112 % (red). The relief draw opens host->router->res and drains all." and line 95: "//   @2 RAISED Node_Strained, node 2 (A+B: 60/80 = 75 %)". The spec Design Notes pin the other ladders: "Router (40 u/s): amber at 1 waiting packet (75 %), red at 2 (150 %); content_host (80): amber at 2, red at 3; residential: red at any waiting packet (600 %) — honest: a stuck house IS critical." — no test or demo exercises those values.
detail: The 80 u/s host ladder is pinned; the 40 u/s router and 5 u/s residential ladder values exist only in prose. A regression in either branch (e.g. residential reading None) passes all 97 tests green.
recommended_fix: Pin two more cases: one stuck packet on the router raises Node_Strained (75%), two raise Node_Critical (150%); one waiting packet at a residential raises Node_Critical (600%), cleared on relief.

title: Pipe-pressure replication to member pipes of a parallel-pipe bundle is never exercised — every crisis test and warn.dem uses single-member bundles
evidence: core/warnings.odin: "The pressure levels replicate to every member pipe of the bundle (the bundle is the capacity unit, 2.1)." Test stream pins only one pipe: "//   @1 RAISED  Pipe_Critical, pipe 0 (6/6 of the E9 bound — dropping)". bundles_test.odin:11-12 exercises parallel pipes only at the bundle level: "(d) the bundle view rebuilds on topology change (rule 1 — adding a parallel pipe to an existing pair grows the bundle's cap, mid-run);" — no crisis state involved (grep: only warnings_test.odin references crisis).
detail: Replication (each member pipe slot derives its own level and emits its own transition events) is specified P0 behavior with zero coverage: no test or demo draws a second parallel pipe under pressure.
recommended_fix: Add a test with two parallel pipes between one pair, six packets piling in the shared lane, asserting both pipe slots raise Pipe_Critical and both clear together.

title: Node Red→Amber easing and node Amber→None (cleared Node_Strained) transitions are unpinned; only the pipe equivalents are tested
detail: node_strain_transition's easing branch (case .Amber when old == .Red) and Amber→None (CLEARED Node_Strained) are separate code from the pinned pipe path; a node-easing regression would pass green.
recommended_fix: Pin a node easing sequence: two stuck packets (red), one drains → CLEARED Node_Critical; last drains → CLEARED Node_Strained, one event per transition.

title: Strain ladder boundary values (exactly 70%/90%, inclusive) untested — pins sample 75%/112% only
evidence:
core/warnings.odin strain_level: "	if pct >= i64(red) do return .Red
	if pct >= i64(amber) do return .Amber". Test pins sample only "2 = 75 % (amber), 3 = 112 % (red)". determinism_test.odin documents the inclusive risk: "zeroed thresholds would make ZERO strain read as Red (strain_level is inclusive)" — no test lands a node on 69/70/89/90/91.
detail: The inclusive >=70/>=90 boundary is the off-by-one risk of the ladder; 30-unit packets vs 80 throughput cannot hit 70% or 90% exactly, so the boundary semantics are never executed.
recommended_fix: Add a fixture node whose throughput makes waiting packets land exactly on 70% and 90% (e.g. throughput 100: 2 packets = 60% None, 3 = 90% Red), asserting the inclusive boundary.

title: Dead-node-slot never-warns path and demolished-node resident packets (E29 drop-back waiting_ticks=0) have no crisis-interaction test
evidence:
core/warnings.odin: "		if !t.node_alive[ns] {
			cr.node_strain[ns] = .None // dead slots never warn". core/flow.odin:753: "	p.waiting_ticks = 0 // 4.1: a severed drop-back re-tries fresh next tick". demolish_test.odin contains no crisis/strain reference (grep across core/*_test.odin: only warnings_test.odin mentions crisis/strain).
detail: Both the dead-slot exclusion and the drop-back counter clearing are 4.1 behavior with no test; a demolished node's stuck packets or a phantom cleared event would pass green.
recommended_fix: Add a test: strain a node, demolish its pipe (E29 drop-back), assert no phantom Cleared event and the re-routed packets never warn.

title: Era-3 sandbox session (goal 0 / cap 0 / era 3) is not pinned by any test
evidence: app/main.odin:32-34: "WIN_GOAL :: u32(0)            // 0 = win/lose disabled (4.1 session)", "LOSE_TICK_CAP :: u64(0)       // 0 = no cap (4.1 session)", "APP_ERA :: u8(3)              // 4.1: the streaming-surge era (director demand + the forecast schedule)". No test or golden asserts goal 0/cap 0 or that the run stays non-terminal through the forecast window.
detail: The sandbox config lives only in app constants; nothing executable verifies win/lose stays disabled (win_lose.odin's goal==0 gate is base, untested for this session) or that the launchable outlasts the surge.
recommended_fix: Add a run-level pin: init goal 0/cap 0/era 3, step past the surge window, assert no Run_Won/Run_Lost terminal and forecast rows present.
